summary_en: ¥260/share annual dividend (¥130 interim + ¥130 year-end) vs. ¥250 prior forecast. Year-end increased ¥5/share to ¥130. FY9/26 net profit upwardly revised to ¥40.0B (+3.9%), supporting payout ratio target of ~40%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of FY9/26 Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Oriental Consultants Holdings revised upward its FY9/26 earnings forecast and dividend forecast on 21 August 2026. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders is now expected to reach ¥40.0 billion, up 3.9% from the prior forecast of ¥38.5 billion, driven by strong domestic public works demand under disaster-prevention initiatives and robust overseas infrastructure demand. The year-end dividend per share is increased by ¥5 to ¥130, resulting in an annual dividend of ¥260/share (¥130 interim plus ¥130 year-end) compared to the prior forecast of ¥250/share. The company targets a payout ratio of approximately 40%, taking into account past earnings trends, future outlook, and capital adequacy metrics. Note: the company executed a 1:2 stock split effective 1 October 2025; prior-period dividends are presented on a pre-split basis.
